run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the index of an extra element in one sorted array using binary search
test_f_gold: test f_gold with two sorted arrays and size n to find the divergence index
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold binary search to find the first mismatch index between two sorted arrays
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses binary search to locate an extra element in a sorted array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that finds the index where two sorted arrays first differ using binary search
